about: Private account-scoped enumeration of immutable successful NIP-17 seal receipts, #13629. No plaintext, keys, intent digests, or signing permission.
ordering: Strict ascending operation ID within the authenticated journal namespace. after is empty or exclusive; next is empty at the observed end, otherwise the last emitted operation. Immutable receipts inserted before a cursor appear on the next pass from the beginning; this is not an atomic snapshot.
authority: The server derives account and canonical identity from the current human session and refuses mismatches. It resolves exactly one journal namespace, including account-merge ambiguity refusal. A page does not authorize a publish or prove delivery: each original and its relay ACK masks still come from the journal.
operation: A fresh canonical 64-hex read reference, echoed exactly by the page. It is distinct from each items[].operation (the immutable seal intent). Clients retain it across an exact uncertain read retry and reject responses for earlier reads.
